sources.review_notes: All 20 pages reviewed against page renders by two reviewer agents (reports/review-pages-0001-0010.md and -0011-0020.md): equations (1)-(52) from the authors' TeX compared with crops (pages 1-10 also compiled with pdflatex), 18 figures, 9 tables and Algorithm 1 checked by crops, theorem-like blocks labelled, references [1]-[78] one entry per item from the PDF text. Verifier diagnostics on pages 5-18 are LaTeX-notation, minus-glyph and algorithm-transcription differences plus two parser artefacts (a '[...](36)' pattern stripped as a Markdown link on page 16, the caron of 'Klaučo' on page 18), adjudicated per page. The page-2 title heading is omitted by the coordinator because the builder emits the generated title.
